name: zanker-content-design
description: Design UI microcopy, errors, empty states and translations consistent with user tasks.

workflow.instruction: Identify user vocabulary, decision impact and content goal.
Write labels and actionable error/recovery texts; avoid placeholder-only inputs.
Test long translations, accents, currency and date formats.
Review content with product stakeholders or users when stakes are meaningful.

fallback: Mark sensitive language for human review.
